title: Spatial product tour
idea: Spatial product tour: A deliberate plan or model reveals meaningful product regions, each tied to a plain explanation and next action.
audience: People who need to explore product regions within a marketing surface.
worksWellWhen: Spatial relationships are essential to understanding the offer.
avoidWhen: A generic orbiting 3D object explains nothing.
distinctFrom: Differs from a generic spatial layout through its explore product regions priority and explicit commitment contract: The selected region exposes only actual supported features and constraints.
navigation: Spatial product tour keeps the current explore product regions context visible; secondary detail has an explicit return path.

composition.entry: A deliberate plan or model reveals meaningful product regions, each tied to a plain explanation and next action.
composition.continuation: Continue with the evidence and controls needed to explore product regions; spatial relationships are essential to understanding the offer.
composition.priority: The selected region exposes only actual supported features and constraints.

imagery.role: Support the actual explore product regions context; essential controls and state remain native.

brandConstraints: Preserve approved identity, semantic roles and licensed assets.
Treat font and palette suggestions as optional; do not replace fixed branding.
responsiveRules: Replace precision gestures with a labelled list and explicit region navigation.
Use a legible phone reading order; media never blocks the primary proposition.

stateContracts.loading: Keep the spatial product tour structure stable while authoritative content resolves; expose unavailable action state.
stateContracts.empty: Explain why no explore product regions content is available and offer a relevant next action.
stateContracts.failure: Preserve safe context and identify the failed operation; The selected region exposes only actual supported features and constraints.
stateContracts.offline: Label cached/unsynchronized explore product regions content and prevent claims of server completion.
stateContracts.success: The selected region exposes only actual supported features and constraints.
stateContracts.interruption: Restore the active explore product regions context safely after navigation, focus loss or platform interruption; do not replay committed actions.

accessibilityRisks: Do not communicate state through color alone; name controls and expose current selection.
Verify reading order, input alternatives, enlarged text and focus restoration for this composition.

performanceBudget.principle: Set an explicit project budget from the actual content/device; no unsupported universal frame or bundle promise.
performanceBudget.verify: Measure initial transfer, layout stability and real image decode cost at the chosen device.

reviewNotes: Original authored candidate; no representative render, independent craft review or task evaluation is attached. Structural validation is not visual validation.
